title: 1993 Playboy Magazine January 1993 - Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a complete January 1993 issue of Playboy Magazine featuring a centerfold. This vintage magazine from the United States is written in English and covers a variety of topics related to women, including modeling. With a monthly publication frequency, this issue offers a glimpse into the cultural and social norms of the early 90s, making it a collectible item for fans of retro magazines or vintage pop culture.
